description: List your own order-book orders (BUY/SELL) with item, price, filled quantity and reserved CWM/goods. By default only OPEN orders, oldest first. Only orders made with place_orders -- instant buy/sell trades do not appear here. Read-only. Returns a list of orders; use cancel_order to withdraw them.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

newest_first.description: Sort newest first instead of oldest first (default false)

name: my_orders
title: List my market orders
